target_customer: Sales teams and revenue operations at B2B companies using Salesforce, with free basic and paid team plans
problem: Salesforce instances average 757 fields, which drains selling time and produces messy data.
business_model: Freemium SaaS with a paid Team plan (20 percent YC discount for six months)

founders.name: Marc Höffl
founders.background_notes: Source YC page. Later Numia role is after Laserfocus.

founders.name: Daniel Dinh
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no bio; he posted the launch post.

competitors.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud with Inbox
competitors.what: Incumbent CRM with its own productivity features that Laserfocus layers over

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs reliable two way Salesforce API sync and a fast UI; routine integration work with edge cases.

defensibility.rationale: Daily workflow habits give some stickiness, but it depends on Salesforce APIs and rivals like Weflow target the same pain.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows Salesforce copying it.

market_need_then: YC launch post cites 757 fields per Salesforce instance as the pain. The Product Hunt launch in July 2022 reached number 2 of the day with 228 upvotes (third party tracker).

identity.visual_style: Clean interface praised by Product Hunt commenters
identity.voice_and_tone: As simple as possible, but not simpler

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: as simple as possible, but not simpler
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch with Michael Seibel as hunter, 228 upvotes and 110 comments per Hunted.

brand_strength.rationale: Evocative name and a strong Product Hunt launch, but little other press and a look alike company named LaserFoc.

outcome_analysis: Laserfocus raised a convertible note of about 500K dollars in March 2020 and launched publicly in 2022 to a strong Product Hunt reception. The website still shows sign up and a 2023 copyright and no shutdown or acquisition was found, yet YC lists the company inactive. The cause is not public and the status may be stale, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: The round rests on CB Insights seen only through a search summary (the page returned 403). Bouncewatch reports about 555K across four pre-seed rounds in 2020, a different shape; unverified. Exit unknown: site is live, YC says Inactive. Salesforce competitor entry is the incumbent, not a startup rival; no dated startup rival found within the window (Weflow raised in Nov 2021, too late).
